title: One San Francisco after-school class had 19 young pupils and one staff member

beats.text: An after-school class in San Francisco had 19 young pupils and one staff member.

visual.sub: One staff member supervised 19 young pupils

beats.text: The limit for this group was 10 children per staff member.
The district said it had applied the limit for older children.

visual.kicker: One staff member supervised 19 young pupils

beats.text: A second staff member arrived in June 2025.

visual.kicker: The district reported an extra staff member arrived in June

beats.text: In October the district reported observing compliant staffing at Charles Drew.

visual.kicker: The district reported an extra staff member arrived in June

beats.text: A separate audit test found four unsigned registration forms among 60 pupils.
A missing signature does not show that the pupil was absent.

visual.kicker: Four of 60 registration forms lacked a signature

beats.text: The district discussed the forms with the lead agency at Roosevelt.

visual.kicker: Four of 60 registration forms lacked a signature

beats.text: On October 6 it checked one completed form at each agency site.

visual.kicker: Two different checks and no questioned costs

beats.text: Each of those forms had a signature.

visual.kicker: Two different checks and no questioned costs

beats.text: The auditors assigned no questioned costs to either finding.

visual.kicker: Two different checks and no questioned costs

beats.text: The report does not show what happened on later days.
